- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:270 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_FAILURE_MARKER_RE` is dead code. The regex is compiled at module import time, but the only call site that referenced it (the early-continue branch around the former line 2519, which read `_FAILURE_MARKER_RE.search(body)` to skip untrusted comments that quoted a marker) was removed by this PR. The function `_canonical_failure_marker` at line 2290-2296 instead uses `_FAILURE_MARKER_TRAILING_RE` (line 282).
  WHY: Wastes import-time compile work and leaves misleading dead code; future readers may think it is referenced and try to use it.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2531 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The compound condition `_comment_author(comment) != author or fields.get("head", "").lower() != head or not _FP_HEX_RE.match(fields.get("fp", ""))` always evaluates the first arm as False, because the enclosing for loop at line 2517 already does `if _comment_author(comment) != author: continue`.
  WHY: No behavioural bug, but the redundant check obscures intent and creates a misleading mental model (the comment still suggests the author is re-checked at the marker-match site).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
